findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: analyze_image · Private data: estimate_cost, analyze_image, compress_image, convert_image, optimize_for_vision, optimize_generated_image · Public sink: estimate_cost, optimize_for_vision · Destructive: get_format_info, analyze_image, compress_image, convert_image, crop_image, image_pipeline.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: analyze_image · Private data: estimate_cost, analyze_image, compress_image, convert_image, optimize_for_vision, optimize_generated_image · Public sink: estimate_cost, optimize_for_vision · Destructive: get_format_info, analyze_image, compress_image, convert_image, crop_image, image_pipeline

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "analyze_image" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
